result.summary: Adds an experimental `bitcoin-mine` executable and an accompanying functional test that connects to `bitcoin-node` over IPC and calls `interfaces::Mining` methods. Moves `interface_ui.cpp` from the node library to the common library so standalone utility binaries can report `InitError` and `InitWarning`. Adds a `mine` subcommand to the `bitcoin` wrapper executable.
result.problem: multiprocess Bitcoin Core development and external mining implementations (such as Stratum v2 template providers) lack an end-to-end test binary to exercise and demonstrate the IPC mining interface outside the node process.
evidence: PR description: 'This is useful as discussed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29432#issuecomment-2222418506 to work on getting mining code working in an external process.'
PR description notes it is 'part of the process separation project (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/28722)'.

enables: External mining process separation and Stratum v2 template provider integration (#29432)

result.scope_notes: Moves node/interface_ui.cpp into the bitcoin_common library, clearing a suppression in contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh. Adds a new internal executable bitcoin-mine built only when both IPC and daemon building are enabled.
result.card: This pull request adds an experimental bitcoin-mine executable and functional test to exercise the Mining IPC interface against bitcoin-node over a Unix domain socket. It provides a working example and test harness for out-of-process mining workflows, including querying chain tips, generating block templates, solving proof of work, and submitting solutions. This helps developers building external mining services, such as Stratum v2 template providers, verify and integrate IPC mining interfaces. The change also moves interface_ui.cpp from the node library to common, resolving an internal dependency issue so standalone binaries can use InitError and InitWarning. It is part of the multiprocess separation project and unblocks external mining architectures.
